method: Actual Chromium, production Flask and Tesseract; database and private Storage simulated; no live records changed

checks.scenario: Communications upload persists a stable private document address and aligned mobile KPI values
A fresh user browser opens the administrator attachment; ordinary users cannot upload
Storage failure retains the complete draft and selected file; retry saves successfully
User memorandum PDF renders all pages with next/previous/download controls at a short mobile height
Same-origin OCR reads every page with live progress, no health-check delay, and preserved manual fields
Native text infers letter purpose for review; a numberless memo generates a number and saves to Office Memos
